exposure: proportion of transfused RBC units collected from female donors (blood donor sex)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 394 very low birth weight preterm infants born at Mater Mothers' Hospital between 2016 and 2022 who received at least one red blood cell transfusion and no other blood products.
finding: The study found no statistically significant associations between blood donor sex and outcomes such as bronchopulmonary dysplasia, late onset infection, retinopathy of prematurity, and mortality in VLBW infants.
